title: The website editor's toolbar, rails and dialogs are readable at night

source.ref: Child of LIVE-EDITOR-SHELL; the night fault LIVE-2308 found and left open (2026-11-16).

detail:
Split from LIVE-EDITOR-SHELL on 2026-11-16. PREMISE RE-TESTED FIRST in a browser, on the real shell at night (the app's .dark), walking the rail tabs, the inspector tabs, the page menu, the publish dialog, the editing state and four hover states, and measuring every painted text node, icon, field and placeholder against what is composited behind it. Before: 118 distinct pairs under the bar (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for icons), most of them between 1.0 and 2.5:1. The cause is one thing in three places.

WHAT WAS WRONG. (1) The generated kit (app/themes/frequency/kit-editor.css, not hand-editable) paints its surfaces as day literals: white glass on the toolbar and both rails, white menus, dialog, block and theme cards and option tiles, a dark ink wash for fields, segments and icon tiles, white for a chosen segment, white text on a pressed button, the ink button and the toast. Its text reads shared tokens that turn cream at night, so night drew cream on white. (2) The editor root is also the element the Site theme styles (lib/sites/editor/theme.ts sets background and color on [data-website-theme], unlayered, over the kit's own): anything in the chrome with no colour of its own wore the Site's ink, so a comment, the publish checklist and the block search drew dark Site ink on the night surface. That is a theme fence leak by day too. (3) The .pe pin handed the shared field form the day ink as its primary on a night surface (1.00:1), and the Design tab's tone swatches read the pinned --color- names, so the White swatch drew the editor's near-black surface instead of the Site's.

WHAT CHANGED, all in the hand-kept sheet beside the kit (app/themes/frequency/editor-shell.css), tokens only, no literal colour. A night block under .dark: surfaces are the raised surface (as glass at the kit's own 82, 72 and 88 percent), washes are the track, a hovered or lit control is the accent wash, a chosen segment is the strong border wash, text on the cream ink and the toast reads text-on-accent, presence initials on the pastel read the palette ink, the switch knob and the swatch rings follow the surface. Small print (row detail and counts, field counts and hints, placeholders) steps from the faint to the muted ink at night, because faint clears 4.5:1 on the night ground but not on a lit, hovered or raised one. One unlayered rule on the editor root puts its ground and inherited ink back on the Frequency tokens the kit already declares. At night the .pe pin follows the app's action pair. The tone swatches read the Site's contract (--th-) by name.

THEME FENCE. No rule names the canvas frame or anything inside it; the frame is a separate document and takes nothing by inheritance. Measured: the canvas region is pixel-identical before and after at 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000, by day and at night. By day the shell is pixel-identical in the default, pages, theme, menu and editing pictures and at every width; the only day differences are the intended ones (the publish checklist, a comment and the block search no longer wear the Site ink, and the tone swatches show the Site's colours).

MEASURED AFTER: 0 pairs under the bar across the same walk (64 to 99 painted items per state). The probe resolves the same thing from the sheets without a browser: night rule over day rule, token through the night block of core.css and the contrast lifts in app/themes/frequency.css, glass and washes composited over what is under them, WCAG contrast for more than fifty pairs. It reports 59 faults on origin/main and none here.

VERIFIED: the probe fails on main and passes here; LIVE-2308, BLD-002 and the editor night-token test still pass unedited; a static harness outside the repo ran the real WebsiteEditorShell and WebsiteCanvas in Chromium over the app CSS in the route import order, before and after, at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000, with the rail tabs, inspector tabs, page menu, publish dialog and editing state at 1440; pictures in the project files under editor/shell-night. NOT VERIFIED: the authenticated route on a deploy; Safari and Firefox (only Chromium is installed here); the Share and versions dialogs, the templates sheet and Pick your look (the harness could not open them); whether the editor root has height in production (it has none in the harness, so the root ground pin could not be seen to matter there).

FOUND, NOT FIXED (outside this row, all present before it): by day the same audit finds 11 pairs under 4.5:1 (placeholders at 2.4 to 2.9, Header and Footer row detail at 3.9, the change count on Publish at 4.1, a field count on a lit row at 4.4); at a 390 viewport with the inspector open the Publish button still runs off the right edge of the toolbar; the phone canvas leaves a white strip of frame ground on its right at night; in the Theme tab the draft name and its caption run together with no space.

verify.note: Fails on main: at night the kit's white surfaces sit under cream text (59 measured pairs, from 1.00:1), the editor root takes its ink from the Site, and the tone swatches read names the chrome pins. Passes once every measured pair clears 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for icons and controls at night, the root's ground and ink are shared tokens, and the night rules hold no literal colour and name nothing inside the canvas frame.
